name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
shortInfo: ₹6,000 per year income support for landholding farmer families.
about: PM-KISAN is a central government scheme that gives income support to landholding farmer families, paid directly into their bank accounts.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year per eligible farmer family
Paid in three equal instalments of ₹2,000
Money sent directly to the bank account (DBT)
eligibility: Landholding farmer families with cultivable land in their name
Income tax payers are not eligible
Institutional landholders, constitutional post holders and certain professionals/pensioners are excluded
howToApply: Go to Farmers Corner → New Farmer Registration
Enter Aadhaar, land and bank details
Or apply through a Common Service Centre (CSC)
lastUpdated: Please verify on the official website

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
shortInfo: Health cover up to ₹5 lakh per family per year for hospital treatment.
about: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY) provides free, cashless hospital treatment at empanelled government and private hospitals.
benefits: Health cover up to ₹5 lakh per family per year
eligibility: Poor and vulnerable families as per SECC-2011 criteria
Senior citizens aged 70+ are eligible regardless of income (Ayushman Vay Vandana card)
Check your eligibility on the official beneficiary portal
howToApply: Check eligibility on the official portal or Ayushman app
Get your Ayushman card from a CSC, empanelled hospital or the app
Show the card at an empanelled hospital for cashless treatment
lastUpdated: Please verify on the official website

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
shortInfo: Small savings scheme for the future of a girl child.
about: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana is a government-backed savings account for a girl child, meant for her education and marriage expenses.
benefits: Attractive interest rate, set by the government every quarter
Tax benefit under Section 80C (old tax regime); maturity amount is tax-free
Partial withdrawal allowed for higher education after the girl turns 18
eligibility: Girl child below 10 years of age
Account opened by parent or legal guardian
Maximum two accounts per family (exception for twins/triplets)
Deposit: minimum ₹250, maximum ₹1.5 lakh per year
documents: Birth certificate of the girl child
howToApply: Visit a post office or authorised bank
Fill the Sukanya Samriddhi account opening form
Submit documents and make the first deposit
lastUpdated: Please verify on the official website

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
shortInfo: Deposit-free LPG connection for women from poor households.
about: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana provides clean cooking fuel (LPG) connections to women from poor households.
benefits: Clean cooking fuel instead of wood or coal
Better health for women and children
eligibility: Adult woman (18+) from a poor household
No existing LPG connection in the same household
Belongs to an eligible category (e.g. SC/ST, PMAY-G, AAY or poor household)
howToApply: Apply on the official PMUY website or at the nearest LPG distributor
Fill the KYC form and submit documents
lastUpdated: Please verify on the official website

name: Atal Pension Yojana
shortInfo: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000–₹5,000 after age 60.
about: Atal Pension Yojana is a government-backed pension scheme, mainly for workers in the unorganised sector.
benefits: Guaranteed pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month after 60
Same pension to spouse after the subscriber's death
Pension wealth returned to the nominee
eligibility: Must have a savings bank or post office account
Income tax payers are not eligible
howToApply: Visit the bank or post office where you have a savings account
Fill the APY registration form (or use net banking)
Contribution is auto-debited from your account
